description: Angular component for selecting and displaying marker icon shapes with color customization, including icon container management and event emission.

classes.name: MarkerIconShapesComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing marker icon shapes with color and container options, emitting selected icon info.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and updates icon containers.

methods.name: selectIcon
methods.description: Selects a new icon and updates icon containers if changed.

methods.name: selectIconContainer
methods.description: Selects a new icon container and marks the component as dirty.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Emits the selected icon and container information.

methods.name: updateIconContainers
methods.description: Updates the list of icon containers with their corresponding HTML elements.
